title: Personal Trainer Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for training services — sessions, packages, nutrition plans, online coaching, assessments and facility fees. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 7 — payment due within 7 days. Packages are non-refundable; unused sessions valid for 6 months.
notes: Thank you for your business. Online coaching billed monthly; pause or cancel anytime with 30 days' notice.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled trainer line items: sessions, packs, nutrition, online coaching, assessment
Package expiry terms printed on the invoice keep policy disputes away
Per-session and pack lines make partial usage easy to track

faqs.q: What should I include on a personal trainer invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client details, a dated line-item list (sessions, packages, nutrition or coaching plans), tax, and a total due. Print package expiry and cancellation terms so clients know the policy up front.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
